description: Follows glycolysis from ATP investment and triose cleavage through aldehyde oxidation and substrate-level phosphorylation, accounting for two net ATP, two NADH and two pyruvate per glucose. Explains NAD+ regeneration through respiration, lactate and alcoholic fermentation and the competing fates of pyruvate.
